metadata.notes: marketOrder is signed exactly like `order` (same sign_l1_action scheme, the 'FrontendMarket' tif is just a note to the matching engine that this is a marketable order) — msgpack is the exact preimage keccak-hashed (with nonce/vaultAddress/expiresAfter appended as raw bytes, per action_hash()) to build the phantom-agent EIP-712 message that source/connectionId wraps. The price (54000) is midPx=50000 with 8% buy-side slippage, rounded to 5 significant figures and (6 - szDecimals=3) decimal places — see packages/core/src/hl/pricing.ts's computeSlippagePrice, ported from the previously-shipped @rabby-wallet/hyperliquid-sdk's getSlippagePx.
